claims.text: The Beatles' single Love Me Do was released on the same day as the premiere of Dr. No, the first James Bond film.
Love Me Do was released in the United Kingdom on 5 October 1962.
Dr. No premiered in London on 5 October 1962.
Sean Connery played James Bond in Dr. No.

Regional: both the Beatles and James Bond are known worldwide. Style: Oxford spelling, straight quotes, no en or em dashes, explanation within 35 words. Myths: screened against myths.json, no hit. Mystery: not applicable to a practice item. Encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: c2 and c3 are exact dates and need sources.
